# GreenCube

> GreenCube is an AI you own. It runs on your own computer, with no usage limits, no subscription and no wifi needed. Pay once: €9.99 (US$9.99).

Instead of renting AI from a company's servers, you buy GreenCube once and the AI runs on your own computer. Nothing is metered, it keeps working without internet, and your chats, documents and images stay on your machine.

## What you can do with it

- **Chat and write**: ask anything; draft emails, essays and applications; rewrite the message you keep getting wrong
- **Code**: write and explain code, scripts and spreadsheet formulas
- **Read anything**: PDFs, contracts, reports, photos, screenshots and charts, summarised and explained
- **Study**: turn a topic or a document into flashcards, quizzes, study tables and clean notes
- **Make real files**: PowerPoint presentations, documents and small web pages you keep and share
- **Look things up**: an optional Online switch searches the web; it is off by default

## Coming soon

- **Build apps and websites by describing them**, plus a full code editor with an AI assistant and a terminal
- **Automations**: give it a job on a schedule, like a morning inbox digest, and get the result on your phone
- **Mac version**

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Tiers: GreenCube reads the machine it is installed on and sorts it into one of four tiers, which set its defaults. Seed (about 8 GB, no graphics card), Sprout (16 GB or more with no graphics card, or 8 GB with a 4 GB card), Bloom (a strong card with 8 GB or more, or a 4 GB card with 16 GB of memory), Thrive (a strong card with 8 GB or more alongside 24 GB or more of memory)
- Memory decides how much fits; a graphics card decides how fast it runs. That is why a card moves a machine further up the list than extra memory does, and why 32 GB with no card is still Sprout: the extra memory widens the context window rather than speeding up the words
- Every tier gets unlimited answers, document reading, flashcards, quizzes, tables and real PowerPoint files. Only model-written slide decks, web pages, image handling and reply continuation differ by tier
- No tier costs more than another: all four are the same app at the same one-time price. Every capability a tier switches off is overridable in Settings (Auto / On / Off), so a limit is always a default and never a cap. The one exception is image generation, which needs 12 GB of memory or more
- Price: €9.99 (US$9.99), one-time payment. No subscription, no recurring fees, no usage limits
- Works fully offline after the first sign-in and model download
- The sign-in only confirms purchase; it never receives conversations, documents or images
- An optional Offline/Online switch enables live web search. It is off by default — only when switched on do searches reach the internet
- Honest limitation: large cloud models are more capable than a model that fits on a personal computer. GreenCube trades some capability for privacy and ownership
- Company: Edunexis SL

## Tests (measured on real PCs by Hector Gras, founder)

- [Can my PC run AI? We measured 10 real gaming PCs and laptops](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/can-my-pc-run-ai): Real speeds on 10 gaming PCs and laptops, plus a free checker: type your graphics card and RAM, see what runs and how fast it ran on a real PC.
- [How we measure AI speed on real PCs, and why we don't guess](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/how-we-measure-ai-speed): Methods, every PC tested, and a test showing spec-based speed estimates were off by up to 239%. Data: https://blog.greencube.app/blog/greencube-ai-speeds.csv
- One page per measured graphics card, e.g. [RTX 3060](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-on-rtx-3060), [RX 6600](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-on-rx-6600), [GTX 1650](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-on-gtx-1650): measured speed, what it means in practice, pictures, and how it compares.
- [Gemma 4 requirements: what PC you need to run it locally](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/gemma-4-requirements): From an 8 GB laptop to a gaming PC: which Gemma 4 fits yours.
- [AI to study from a PDF: we asked 12 questions about 3 long documents](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-to-study-from-pdf): Right 11 times out of 12, in about 15 seconds per question.
- [ChatGPT free limits in 2026: is it unlimited now?](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/chatgpt-free-limits): ChatGPT chat is unlimited now. PDFs and pictures aren’t.
- [Local AI image generator on your PC: how long one picture takes](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/local-ai-image-generator-speed): From 28 seconds to 11 minutes, depending on your PC.
- [How much VRAM do you need for AI? Why the model must fit on your GPU](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/how-much-vram-for-ai): Spill out of VRAM and it gets 6 times slower.
- [Run AI on a laptop without a graphics card: do Intel graphics help?](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-on-laptop-without-gpu): Chat: about the same. Pictures: 4 times faster.
- [Gemma 4 E2B vs E4B on a laptop: small vs big AI model, measured](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/gemma-4-e2b-vs-e4b): Small: 20 seconds. Big: 112. Here's what you lose.
- [Can you run AI with 8 GB of RAM? We tried the weakest laptop we have](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/run-ai-on-8gb-ram): Yes, slowly. The catch is free memory, not speed.
- [Which AI doesn't train on your chats? We checked 9](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-that-doesnt-train-on-your-data): ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, NotebookLM, Copilot, Perplexity, Mistral, DeepSeek and Meta AI, from their own help pages (October 2026), with how to turn training off and what that doesn't cover.
- [AI to summarize your notes: limits and privacy](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/ai-to-summarize-notes): free upload limits and training rules of NotebookLM, ChatGPT and Gemini, versus an AI on your own PC, with measured times.
- [Offline AI for students, tested](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/offline-ai-for-students): what works on a laptop with no internet, with measured times on 8 GB and 16 GB laptops and gaming PCs.
- [Blog en español](https://blog.greencube.app/blog/es): the same tests in Spanish
